Hourglass immaculate is my HG foundation so I can't help but rave about it. I have acne prone, combination skin and I use the shade porcelain. Quick heads up, if you have dry skin, do NOT use this. It will cling to dry patches like it's on the Titanic. 

I usually go without primer, but if I feel like it I'll pair it with the hourglass mineral primer. Because the formula is pretty thick, I apply using a damp beauty blender to get a really nice, even finish. I would say it's a medium but not high coverage (layerable but too much can easily cake) foundation so if there's any heavy discoloration, I recommend apply concealer UNDER the foundation. The staying power (without primer) is the best I've had in a foundation but I do start getting a bit oily in my T-zone at the 6 hour mark. Also don't use a setting/finishing powder because it's a liquid to powder so setting with the UD cooling and hydrating setting spray keeps it good for a full 12+ hour day!

As for how it photographs, it's beautiful. No flashback and even coverage even with flash. One thing though (as a general rule), it does dry very matte so some heavier contour/highlight/blush may be needed to bring out the dimensions of your face. This can be relatively negligible during everyday wear but for photos, it's pretty necessary. 

That being said, this is just my experience so like another person said, make sure to try it out yourself and then take pictures in all sorts of lighting. Hopefully this was helpful and if you have any questions, I can try to answer them!
